metadata.description: Get the list of Landing Page Folders.
metadata.learn_more: Get the list of Landing Page Folders. Supports paging and filtering. This method would be useful for an integration that examined these models and used an external service to suggest edits.

after.label: After
after.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Specifies whether to return deleted Folders. Defaults to `false`.

createdAfter.label: Created After
createdAfter.description: Filter folders created after the specified date and time.

createdAt.label: Created At
createdAt.description: Only return Folders created at exactly the specified time.

createdBefore.label: Created Before
createdBefore.description: Only return Folders created before the specified time.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default is 100.

property.label: Property
property.description: Specifies which properties of the landing page folders to include in the response.

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Specifies which fields to use for sorting results. Valid fields are `name`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `createdBy`, `updatedBy`. `createdAt` will be used by default.

updatedAfter.label: Updated After
updatedAfter.description: Only return Folders last updated after the specified time.

updatedAt.label: Updated At
updatedAt.description: Only return Folders last updated at exactly the specified time.

updatedBefore.label: Updated Before
updatedBefore.description: Only return Folders last updated before the specified time.
